admin.heading: The Strategic Vision
paragraphs: I am Mariangel Sierra Jaller, a professional passionate about efficient management and administrative control. I firmly believe that what is not measured cannot be controlled, and I see resource optimization as the foundational pillar of business success.

My multidisciplinary training in Industrial and Systems Engineering has shaped a deep analytical mindset. I have cultivated research and strategic planning skills that let me tackle complex operational challenges with responsibility, initiative and solid critical thinking.

Throughout my career in finance and procurement, I have standardized workflows, led audits and efficiently managed the supply chain. I see administration not just as cost or inventory control, but as an active tool to generate measurable, sustainable value.

My academic and professional experiences have forged a versatile profile, capable of aligning operational efficiency with the strategic goals of the business — ensuring continuity, transparency and continuous growth.

tech.heading: The Analytical Mindset
tech.subheading: Building bridges between data and action
paragraphs: I am Mariangel Sierra Jaller, a Systems and Industrial Engineering student with a deep curiosity for how technology can transform complex processes and make people's lives easier.
I see learning as a continuous journey. This conviction has driven me to be proactive in mastering data analysis tools, workflow automation (ETL) and complex ERP ecosystems such as NetSuite.

My technical focus is not limited to databases; I aim to integrate technology with Business Intelligence (BI). I am motivated to design logical solutions, process structured data and build interactive dashboards that tell the real story behind the numbers and remove bottlenecks.

This blend of technical capability and functional understanding makes me a professional able to lead digital transformation, bringing operational efficiency and data-driven innovation to any corporate environment.
